definition: Sentence has factual atoms, forbidden-action atoms, and recursively formed conditionals. An embedded atom uses the same constructor as its free-standing occurrence. The conditional is a sentence constructor, not an assertion of its antecedent.
note: Analyst reconstruction for #185, motivated by the already pinned secondary account SEP-MORAL-COGNITIVISM §2.5. Exact conditional clauses and the psychological adequacy of compatible-state acceptance remain separate historical/fidelity obligations; see docs/expressivist-embedding-boundary.md. This models a possible planning language without asserting it is ordinary moral language.
